$comment: Real cut inventory per font family, hand-curated — the face-existence gate (test/engine/categories.mjs, per docs/reference/typography/intended-use.md Layer 2) checks preset styleName/weights ONLY against families listed here; an unlisted family is unresolvable and skipped. Static families: cut names generate as width × weight (+ Italic). Variable families: any weight inside the range is real. Verify against the actual name tables (fontTools) before adding a family — assumed cuts are how the GT America Semi-bold defect shipped (#402).

$comment3: Below: added 2026-07-31 — independent digital foundries (Klim, Lineto, Pangram Pangram), each ONE canonical release with no competing-lineage ambiguity (unlike the vintage-revival Clarendon/Trade-Gothic class above).
